description: This file defines an OpenCart admin controller class for managing the 'Product Viewed' report extension. It includes methods for displaying report configuration, generating reports, saving settings, and installing/uninstalling the module.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Product Viewed report extension in the OpenCart admin panel, including configuration, report generation, and module management methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the report configuration form page in the admin panel.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of report settings via POST request, returning JSON response.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the report extension by invoking the associated model method.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the report extension by invoking the associated model method.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the actual product viewed report in the admin panel.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list, typically for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the product viewed report HTML with pagination.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Stub method intended for generating report data; currently only returns a success message.
